queries.ground_truth_origin: derived by the reference from synthetic card fields, not authored here

metric_definitions.P@1: relevant ids among the top 1, divided by 1
metric_definitions.P@5: relevant ids among the top 5, divided by 5
metric_definitions.R@5: relevant ids among the top 5, divided by |relevant|
metric_definitions.MRR: reciprocal rank of the first relevant id, 0 when none appears
metric_definitions.nDCG@5: DCG of binary gains over the top 5, divided by the ideal DCG - the reference's dcg()/ndcg_at()
metric_definitions.per_category: the same figures grouped by the reference's query category
metric_definitions.zero_result_safety: for the 기권(정답없음) category, the share of queries returning no result
metric_definitions.stale_id_execution: lookups by an id no longer in the store that still return a card
metric_definitions.rank_stability: identical ordering across repeated identical queries
metric_definitions.latency_p50_p95: wall-clock milliseconds per query inside the JVM adapter
metric_definitions.keyword_fallback_ratio: share of queries whose RetrievalResponse.mode fell back to KEYWORD_ONLY
metric_definitions.semantic_executed: whether any query actually ran the semantic axis

gates.note: no numeric gate is declared. This run is diagnostic: it measures the current production search path on the reference dataset. Declaring a threshold after seeing the number would be meaningless, and declaring one before would be arbitrary without a baseline.

what_this_run_is: production adapter - the current Kotlin SearchLookupService on the reference dataset
what_this_run_is_not: the reference evaluator's own numbers; those could not be produced (see blocker)
